verdict.rationale: Turning feedback into scoped tasks is a fair question for an agent platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no documented feature that converts user feedback submissions into structured tasks with proposed scope. The closest items are adjacent: incident triage that suggests severity and routes issues (openhands-docs-7), generic Linear/GitHub automations, and an SDK example for building a custom planning agent, which is a developer building block rather than this capability.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can convert user feedback submissions into structured tasks with proposed scope
